content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius regional district court the case involved the division of matrimonial property between the plaintiff and the defendant the defendant was responsible for paying stamp duty and professional fees while both parties were responsible for paying stamp duty the court awarded a jeep grand cherokee to the plaintiff and determined that the defendant must pay compensation to the plaintiff for the loss of property and community property the court also stated that the parties have joint obligations under a consumer credit agreement the text discusses various articles of the civil code related to matrimonial property including the essence of the statutory matrimonial property regime methods of dividing property and the right to compensation the applicant is seeking to dissolve the marriage and is requesting the division of various properties as well as compensation from the defendant the defendant has filed a counterclaim with similar requests the court will now make a decision on the case the law provides two options for dividing matrimonial property through an agreement between the spouses or through a court decision in this case the defendant acquired a plot of land and buildings using personal funds and the claimant agrees to the spouses ownership of the property the court decides to divide the real estate property between the parties and awards the vehicle to the defendant the value of the property and compensation are determined based on market prices and contributions made by each party the court dissolves the marriage and assigns the respective properties to each party the decision can be appealed within 30 days

metadata.cost: - € 867,00 (stamp duty) + € 1 585,00 (professional fees) to be borne by the defendant; € 867,00 (stamp duty) to be borne by the plaintiff
